# Import Notes

- Upstream repository: https://github.com/srlcarlg/srl-python-indicators
- Upstream branch: `master`
- Upstream license: Apache-2.0
- Imported into: `third_party/srl-python-indicators/`
- Imported scope: Python indicator source modules, `models_utils/` support modules, README, and upstream LICENSE.
- Excluded scope: sample market-data files, Parquet datasets, notebooks, rendered images, and test data.
